dimensions.description: The complete consumer preserves the shared coverage, grounding, uncertainty, terminology, and work-product behavior that the ablated consumer lacks.
Both arms keep the Agent Writing task and agent-specific behavior fixed while only the Foundation invocation varies.

evals.name: complete-agent-writing-consumer
evals.prompt: Create agent instructions for validating `deploy-plan.json`. Account for the required success and failure branches, preserve the canonical term `DAG frontier` and JSON literal `{"maxAttempts":3}`, keep the unresolved retry owner visible, and complete only after reporting the observed result. Run the same host-neutral scenario for the complete consumer and a test-only ablation of its Foundation invocation.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer invokes Writing Foundation and preserves shared coverage, grounding, uncertainty, exact terminology, work-product fidelity, and completion behavior beyond the dependency-ablated control.
expectations: The treatment records writing-foundation and agent-writing as canonical invocations.
The treatment accounts for both branches and the unresolved owner.
The treatment preserves the exact canonical term and JSON literal.
The ablated control removes only the writing-foundation invocation through the test Adapter boundary.
A missing production dependency is not used as either arm.
